claims.claim: Very clean ps4 slim special edition with follow come controller and other accessories
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a silver/gray laptop with an “A” logo; no PS4 is shown.

claims.claim: It comes with follow come controller and other accessories
claims.evidence: No controller or PS4 accessories are shown in the witness photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No internal inspection, seals, or repair indicators are shown; also the item shown appears to be a laptop, not a PS4.
No temperature/usage test or evidence of cooling performance is shown.
No port testing is shown; and the witness photos do not show a PS4.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: No pads/controllers or receipt are shown in the witness photos.

risks.risk: Item mismatch / possible scam: witness photos show a laptop, while seller claims a PS4 Slim Special Edition.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo/video showing the exact console (PS4 Slim Special Edition) with the controller(s) and accessories laid out, plus the model/serial label visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not matching the described item (worst case: treat as a generic laptop with unknown specs, or do not price until identity is confirmed).

risks.risk: Unknown laptop specs and condition (screen, keyboard, trackpad, storage/RAM, battery, ports, damage).
risks.proof: Request: (1) screen-on video showing display clarity, (2) keyboard close-up, (3) trackpad close-up, (4) BIOS/boot screen or system info showing CPU/RAM/storage/OS, (5) battery health screenshot, (6) ports close-ups, (7) underside photo for model/serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for unknown condition: as-is with unknown functionality (screen/keyboard/battery/drive unverified).

risks.risk: Potential hidden physical damage (cracks, dents, water damage, repairs) not visible from the limited exterior angle.
risks.proof: Request: close-up photos of hinges, corners, keyboard deck, and bottom cover; plus a flashlight check for water marks and any repair screws.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly damaged/repair-needed due to lack of evidence.

risks.risk: Missing charger/adapter and accessories (critical for laptops; also critical for PS4 claim).
risks.proof: Request: photo of the exact charger/adapter model label and a video showing charging indicator/port fit; if PS4 is intended, show the exact included cables and controller(s).
risks.if_unproven: Price as without charger/accessories (worst case: cannot test/operate).

proof_requests: Send clear photos that confirm the exact item: PS4 Slim Special Edition (if that’s what you’re selling) with the console model/serial label readable, plus the controller(s) and accessories laid out.
If it is actually a laptop, send: screen-on video, keyboard/trackpad close-ups, system info (CPU/RAM/storage/OS), battery health screenshot, ports close-ups, and underside model/serial label photo.
Show the charger/adapter (exact model label) and a short charging/boot test video.
response.reason: The witness photos show a laptop, but the seller claims a PS4 Slim Special Edition with controllers and receipts. This mismatch is a strong red flag and prevents safe pricing based on the described item.
